name: Awesome Foundation Conservation and Climate microgrants

funder.name: The Awesome Foundation (Conservation and Climate chapter)

summary: Volunteer-funded micro-grants of around US$1,000 for individuals or small teams with innovative wildlife, habitat protection or climate projects. Salaries, operating costs and established projects are not funded.

amount.note: Projects whose funding gap is $1000 or less; the amount is not stated outright

eligibility.rule: Can receive funds through a PayPal, Wise, or Venmo account
Not an established project or about politics or religion; no personal, marketing, salary, operating or travel costs
Has not won a grant from this chapter in the last 12 months

applicant_types.quote: If you are an individual or small team, with an awesome idea that will help the environment, you are encouraged to apply.

access.quote: If you are an individual or small team, with an awesome idea that will help the environment, you are encouraged to apply.

amount.quote: Projects that have a "tipping point" of $1000 or less where our grant will be the difference between it not happening and making dreams come true.

effort.quote: Deadlines: September 25, 2026 November 27, 2026 January 29, 2027 March 26, 2027 May 28, 2027 July 30, 2027 September 24, 2027 November 26, 2027

eligibility.quote: Applicants must have, or be able to get, a PayPal, Wise, or Venmo account to receive funds if they win a micro grant.
Personal expenses, marketing, salaries, operational expenses, established projects, travel expenses, things having to do with politics or religion.
If you have won a grant, please wait 12 months before applying again.
